Pose - Hand Extended.name: Pose - Hand Extended
Pose - Hand Extended.description:
🕴️ Pose: Hand Extended
Reaching one hand toward the viewer — offering, beckoning, casting, or presenting something.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Hand Extended.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, extend one frame-visible arm toward the viewer with an open palm or spread fingers, lean the torso slightly into the gesture, and keep the other visible arm positioned for balance. Avoid extreme foreshortening unless the selected frame supports it. Female: the reaching shoulder stays low, wrist soft. Male: the reaching shoulder squares forward, wrist firm. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own reach.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
